_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the Uptime Kuma egg in pterodactyl/application-eggs (MIT).
name: Uptime Kuma
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Uptime Kuma is a self-hosted monitoring tool for websites, servers and services, with alerts and status pages. Open the server's address to set it up.
startup: h=$( (node --version; cat package-lock.json) | sha256sum | cut -d" " -f1); if [ "$h" != "$(cat node_modules/.raptor-installed 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo "Installing Uptime Kuma's dependencies"; npm ci --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel=error && npm cache clean --force --loglevel=error && echo "$h" > node_modules/.raptor-installed || exit 1; fi; exec node server/server.js --port={{SERVER_PORT}} --data-dir=./data/

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Uptime Kuma: downloads the release for the chosen version from GitHub
# (its web interface checked against GitHub's checksum). The data folder
# (monitors, settings, history) is never touched. Its dependencies are
# installed when the server starts, for the Node.js version it runs.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
# Downloads unpack in a folder in the server's (the install's /tmp is
# small), removed when the script ends.
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
rm -rf .raptor-new
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) arch=amd64 ;;
    aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
    *) fail "This server's CPU ($(uname -m)) isn't supported." ;;
esac
download() {
    curl -fsSL -o "$2.part" "$1" || { rm -f "$2.part"; fail "The download failed ($1). Reinstall to try again."; }
    if [ -n "${3:-}" ] && [ "$(sha256sum "$2.part" | cut -d' ' -f1)" != "$3" ]; then
        rm -f "$2.part"; fail "The download didn't match its checksum. Reinstall to try again."
    fi
    mv -f "$2.part" "$2"
}
put_release() {
    local new=$1 e; shift
    local keep=" $* "
    if [ -f .raptor-files ]; then
        while IFS= read -r e; do
            if [ -n "$e" ] && [ ! -e "$new/$e" ] && [ "${keep#* "$e" }" = "$keep" ]; then rm -rf -- "./$e"; fi
        done < .raptor-files
    fi
    : > .raptor-files.new
    while IFS= read -r e; do
        if [ "${keep#* "$e" }" != "$keep" ] && [ -e "./$e" ]; then
            if [ -d "$new/$e" ]; then cp -rn "$new/$e/." "./$e/" || true; fi
        else
            rm -rf -- "./$e"
            mv "$new/$e" "./$e"
        fi
        echo "$e" >> .raptor-files.new
    done < <(find "$new" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -printf '%f\n')
    mv -f .raptor-files.new .raptor-files
    rm -rf "$new"
}

want="${VERSION:-latest}"
version=$(gh-release tag louislam/uptime-kuma "$want") || fail "Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 2.0.0, then reinstall."

if [ -f package.json ] && [ "$(jq -r .version package.json)" = "$version" ] && [ -d dist ]; then
    echo "Uptime Kuma $version is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading Uptime Kuma $version"
    download "https://github.com/louislam/uptime-kuma/archive/refs/tags/$version.tar.gz" $work/kuma.tar.gz
    gh-release download louislam/uptime-kuma "$version" dist.tar.gz $work/dist.tar.gz
    mkdir .raptor-new
    tar -xzf $work/kuma.tar.gz -C .raptor-new --strip-components=1
    tar -xzf $work/dist.tar.gz -C .raptor-new
    rm -rf $work/kuma.tar.gz $work/dist.tar.gz .raptor-new/data .raptor-new/docker .raptor-new/.github
    put_release .raptor-new data
fi
mkdir -p data
echo "Installed Uptime Kuma $version."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Uptime Kuma version to install, such as 2.0.0, or latest. Reinstall to change it.
